# `ui_part`

A widget put into a slot of a screen, in `order`, shown while its `if` holds (12 §10.6).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `into` (string; **required**): The slot, by its qualified name: the namespace of the screen that places it, a colon, and the slot's name, as in `ui:hud.bars`. A bare name means a slot of the part's own mod.
- `order` (whole number; optional): Where the part comes among the others in the slot: lower first, and parts of equal order by qualified id. Left out, 0.
- `if` ([`Prop`](#prop), or `null`; optional): `if`: the part is shown, and takes space, only while this holds.
- `required` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether the slot must exist. Left out, true: a part aimed at a slot that no screen places is a load error. With `false` such a part is simply not shown.
- `widget` (object; **required**): The widget, or any layout node.

<a id="prop"></a>
### `Prop`

A widget property that is either written outright or computed.

A `Bound` property holds its `Binding`: the source of an expression or a text template and, once the screen's definition has been compiled, the compiled form. A screen shows a placeholder for one that was never compiled or never evaluated.

Written as true, false, or a condition as a string or `{ "expr": … }`.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- an object: object [`ExprObject`](#exprobject)
- a boolean
- a null

<a id="exprobject"></a>
### `ExprObject`

`{ "expr": "…" }`, the long way to write an expression (04 §7.1).

- `expr` ([`Binding`](#binding); **required**): The expression, as a string.

<a id="binding"></a>
### `Binding`

The source of a bound property: an expression or a text template, where it was written, and, once its definition has been compiled, its compiled form.

A binding read by anything but the mod loader has no place and is never compiled: a screen made from it shows a placeholder.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- an object: object [`ExprObject`](#exprobject)
